market_view: The market is in a severe risk-off regime with QQQ down -2.7%, VIXY up 6.5%, and most IT stocks under pressure. Intel is collapsing on disastrous guidance, dragging AMD and the semiconductor complex lower. We are prioritizing capital preservation: exiting longs that are below VWAP with no reversal, and only adding high-liquidity longs that are above VWAP with confirmed momentum.
